rawText:
<observations>
Date: Mar 20 - Mar 29, 2026
* 🔴 User decisions & architecture: Enforced strict null checks and repo-wide TypeScript strict mode; switched production database from SQLite to PostgreSQL; adopted semantic commit messages; SOC 2 audit fieldwork starts May 19, 2026; public API rate limit raised to 500 requests/min.
* 🟡 Key feature milestones & tooling:
  * CI pipeline optimized with `node_modules` caching and Percy visual regression tests.
  * Enforced 85% Jest test coverage.
  * Implemented LaunchDarkly feature flags, ConfigCat "recurringPause" toggle, and nodemailer overdue invoice notifications.
  * Integrated pdf-lib for invoices, SheetJS for bulk `.xlsx` invoice uploads, and pino for JSON logging.
  * Completed PR merges: PR #42 (reviewed by @sara), PR #58 locale-aware dates (merged after approval from @mike), and dark mode UI deployment to staging.

Date: Apr 2, 2026
* 🔴 (11:40) User asked whether PDF invoices could include a company logo watermark.
* 🟡 (15:05) Added BullMQ background job to process asynchronous PDF generation after staging CPU spike.
* ✅ (17:45) Merged branch feature/recurring-invoices into develop after approval from @kim (includes recurring invoice templates table, API endpoints, and pdfmake dynamic watermarks deployed to staging).

Date: Apr 6, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to integrate Stripe for subscription payments in Ledgerly.
* 🟡 (07:50) Created `stripeService.ts` and webhook endpoint `/api/v1/payments/stripe/webhook` handling `charge.succeeded` and `invoice.payment_failed`.
* 🔴 (11:35) User asked whether payment receipt emails could include a QR code linking to the invoice.
* ✅ (13:00) Deployed Stripe integration and qrcode-generated email attachments to development for review.
* 🟡 (15:40) Added nightly cron database cleanup script to prune orphaned payment records (local dev DB reached 3.2 GB).
* 🟡 (16:30) Adopted Redis Streams for background job queues and added Snyk security scanning to CI.
* ✅ (18:20) Merged branch feature/stripe-integration into main after approval from @alex.
</observations>
